description: This file defines an enumeration called DBStatus that represents different local change states for notes in the Nextcloud Notes Android client, used for server synchronization.

classes.name: DBStatus
classes.description: Enum used to distinguish between different local change types for server synchronization. It includes statuses like VOID, LOCAL_EDITED, and LOCAL_DELETED.

methods.name: getTitle
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the status, such as 'LOCAL_EDITED' or 'LOCAL_DELETED'.

methods.name: DBStatus
methods.description: Constructor to initialize the DBStatus enum with a specific string title.
